items.company_name: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises Inc. Common Stock
items.title: Babcock & Wilcox Announces Full Redemption of Notes
items.summary: B&W issued a notice of redemption for all $61.4 million aggregate principal amount outstanding of our 6.50% Senior Notes due 2026, which were issued pursuant to an indenture, dated as of February 12, 2021, as supplemented by the First Supplemental indenture, dated as of February 12, 2021, and further supplemented by the Second Supplemental indenture, dated as of December 13, 2021, between us and The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A., as trustee.

items.company_name: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises Inc. Common Stock
items.title: Babcock & Wilcox Board Authorizes Share Repurchase Program of Up to $50 Million
items.summary: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises, Inc. today announced that its Board of Directors has authorized a share repurchase program of up to $50 million of the Company's outstanding common stock. The Company expects to begin repurchases following the filing of its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the second quarter of 2026.

items.company_name: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises Inc. Common Stock
items.title: Babcock & Wilcox to Support TerraSpark’s Development Efforts for 1.6 GW Coal-fired Power Plant Project in West Virginia
items.summary: Babcock & Wilcox today announced it is collaborating with TerraSpark in support of its planned energy generation project in West Virginia. The project, known as the TerraSpark Energy Campus, will include a 1.6-gigawatt coal-fired power plant, a multi-industry campus and a Coal Innovation & Training Center for rare earth extraction and advanced materials initiatives.

items.summary: B&W CEO Kenny Young appeared on CNBC’s Mad Money with Jim Cramer to discuss B&W's strong results and exciting future.

items.company_name: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises Inc. Common Stock
items.title: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises Announces Closing of Common Stock Offering
items.summary: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises, Inc. announced today the closing of its previously announced underwritten public offering of 12,432,432 shares of its common stock at a price to the public of $18.50 per share (the “Offering”).

items.company_name: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises Inc. Common Stock
items.title: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises Announces Pricing of Common Stock Offering
items.summary: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises, Inc. announced that it priced an underwritten public offering of 10,810,811 shares of its common stock at a price to the public of $18.50 per share (the “Offering”), for gross proceeds of approximately $200 million, before deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by the Company.

items.company_name: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises Inc. Common Stock
items.title: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises Announces Proposed Public Offering of Common Stock
items.summary: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises, Inc. announced the commencement of an underwritten public offering of $200 million of its common stock (the “Offering”). The Company expects to grant the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 15% of its common stock sold in the proposed offering. All of the shares in the Offering are being offered by B&W.

items.company_name: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises Inc. Common Stock
items.title: Babcock & Wilcox Secures $21 Million for Fuel Switching Technology Awards; Parts and Services Continues Strong Performance Driven by Increased Baseload Demand
items.summary: B&W announced today that it has recently secured awards of more than $21 million for fuel switching technologies in the United States reflecting the increased utilization of coal and natural gas power plants. This increased demand for power is also driving continued strong performance in the Company’s parts and services business.

items.title: Babcock & Wilcox Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results
items.summary: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises, Inc. announced it has entered into an agreement for the full notice to proceed on a $2.4 billion project with Base Electron, backed by Applied Digital, advancing the November 2025 limited notice to proceed for 1.2 GW of efficient natural gas technology for AI Factory campuses. The company also announced its financial results for the fourth quarter and full year 2025.
